hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: No commodity hedging. The 7 derivative mentions relate to embedded conversion option liabilities on convertible promissory notes valued using Black-Scholes, not commodity hedging instruments.

metadata.notes: Fiscal year ended April 30, 2013. Production and per-BOE metrics from item7 table. Reserves in Bbls (oil) and Mcf (gas) - proved oil reserves = 47,580 Bbls, proved gas reserves = 26,160 Mcf, total proved = 51,940 BOE as of April 30, 2013. Proved developed = 39,950 oil Bbls, 24,050 gas Mcf, 43,558 BOE. Proved undeveloped = 7,630 oil Bbls, 2,110 gas Mcf, 8,382 BOE. Revenue: oil $765,548, gas $47,214, total $812,762. LOE $72,248. Average prices realized: oil $102.50/Bbl, gas $5.25/Mcf, total $90.63/BOE. Production 83% oil, 17% gas. LOE includes ad valorem taxes. Derivative mentions are convertible note embedded conversion option liabilities ($63,671 fair value) and stock options, not commodity hedges.
